De harmonia mundi totius (Francesco Giorgi (Giorgio Veneto), 1545)
Public domain. Sourced from Internet Archive: the 1545 Paris Latin edition (Cantica tria) (https://archive.org/details/FranciscusGeorgiusVenetusDeHarmoniaMundiTotiusParis1545). Giorgi's three canticles on the harmony of the whole world: Christian Kabbalah, the music of the spheres, and the concord of macrocosm and microcosm — the Franciscan friar's great Renaissance synthesis, in Latin.
